name: @store-mcp/monorepo
description: Unified MCP Server for Google Play & Apple App Store

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @store-mcp/shared && npm run build --workspace @store-mcp/play-operate && npm run build --workspace @store-mcp/appstore-operate && tsc
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && python3 -m unittest discover -s packages/play-analytics -p "test_*.py" && node --test dist/**/*.test.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @store-mcp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @store-mcp/play-operate && npm run typecheck --workspace @store-mcp/appstore-operate && tsc --noEmit
